description: This file provides utility functions and a class for generating Sphinx-based documentation, including methods for writing headings, toctrees, and tables in reStructuredText format.

classes.name: DocumentWriter
classes.description: A class that provides methods to generate reStructuredText content for Sphinx documentation, including writing headings, toctrees, and tables.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Class method to open a file with specified encoding and return a DocumentWriter instance.

methods.name: write_heading
methods.description: Method to write a heading with specified level, optional index ID, and label.

methods.name: write_toctree
methods.description: Method to write a toctree with entries, optional title, and maximum depth.

methods.name: write_table
methods.description: Method to write a simple reStructuredText table based on a behave.model.Table object.
